verdict: Evidence strongly indicates premeditated homicide with deliberate concealment of physical evidence.
reasoning: Convergent postmortem indicators establish a TOD window of 02:00–04:00 AM. Full rigor and fixed anterior lividity are internally consistent at 7–8 h PMI. Sedative levels above therapeutic threshold, combined with blunt-force cranial injury and defensive bruising absent on upper limbs, are consistent with victim being incapacitated prior to fatal assault. Post-mortem body repositioning, evidenced by lividity pattern, indicates deliberate concealment of the crime scene.
